title: Product Description & Bullets Writer - input schema

products.description: List of products to generate descriptions for

use_openai.description: If true, actor will try to use OPENAI_API_KEY env var or input.openai_api_key

openai_api_key.description: Optional: OpenAI API key (prefer env variable OPENAI_API_KEY). If omitted and use_openai=true, actor will fallback to template generator.
